# 2032. Two Out of Three

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def twoOutOfThree(self, nums1, nums2, nums3):
        """
        :type nums1: List[int]
        :type nums2: List[int]
        :type nums3: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        cnt = collections.Counter(list(set(nums1)) + list(set(nums2)) + list(set(nums3)))
        ans = []
        for k, v in cnt.items():
            if v >= 2:
                ans.append(k)
        return ans
```
